mission: Harden Capability Genome economic fitness so impossible telemetry cannot manufacture attractive supplier scores.

defect.before: capabilityFitness silently clamped or zeroed impossible values such as taskSuccess > 1, negative reliability, negative costs/burdens, and evidenceConfidence > 1, allowing malformed telemetry to produce plausible-looking economic scores.
defect.after: unit-interval fields outside [0,1] and negative cost/burden fields fail closed as ECONOMIC_PRIOR_REJECTED with score=null; valid inputs remain ESTIMATED_PRIOR_NOT_REVENUE.

expectedVerification: Exact-head CI or deterministic local Node test execution must pass before merge readiness is claimed.
